gaps: High-concept literary storytelling (Premchand-style emotional realism) without relying on absurd fantasy tropes (e.g., every beggar turning out to be a secret royal).
Satisfying single-video resolution or full movies over dragged-out multi-part series (episodic finales perform far worse, e.g., Crorepati Delivery Boy Ep 5 drops to 0.36 vsNormal).
Grounded emotional stories focusing on deep family sacrifices rather than purely sensationalist clickbait twists.
saturated: Secret billionaire disguised as a beggar/waiter/auto-driver.
Cruel stepmother/aunt kicking out innocent daughter for property.
Over-exaggerated revenge plots lacking logical emotional grounding.

[Insult of Wife/Mother] + [Husband/Son Reveals Secret Royalty/Wealth] + [Curiosity Hook: फिर जो हुआ/उड़ गए होश]
